prayerExcerpt.en-US: He that giveth to the poor shall not want.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Aquele que dá ao pobre não passará necessidade.

meta.face: A Catalan of about thirty-six with a sun-browned olive complexion and a SHORT, BROAD face with a WIDE, gently BULGING forehead and a strong brow — deep-set, intense black eyes under thick, ARCHED black brows, a SHORT, straight nose with a HIGH, narrow bridge, flat cheeks, a WIDE mouth with a full lower lip, a ROUND, prominent chin; a close, short black beard and moustache; black hair in a thin ring round a large tonsure; the gaze direct and steadfast. Not the long, narrow, single-browed romanus_ostiarius, the long, soft-faced francis_caracciolo or the broad, flat-cheeked william_montevergine.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives; the Spanish Baroque paintings (the Camón Aznar canvas on Wikipedia) give him a dark beard and the Mercedarian habit and shield. The cardinal's red is left out because the cardinalate has been shown to be a confusion (Paravicini Bagliani, cited by Wikipedia). The face is ours.
